mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_quiz_status (user_id, quiz_id, is_solved, is_correct, answer, solved_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{quizId}, #{isSolved}, #{isCorrect}, #{answer}, #{solvedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE is_solved = VALUES (is_solved), is_correct = VALUES (is_correct), answer = VALUES (answer), solved_at = VALUES (solved_at)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM user_quiz_status WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_solved = 1 ORDER BY RAND()
